en.jit.setup.title: Set up JIT
en.jit.setup.intro: Set up once, then open a game. LSX4 enables JIT automatically on this iPhone.
en.jit.setup.computer: The first installation and this iPhone’s pairing file require your computer. Your Apple Account signs your own copy of LSX4.
en.jit.setup.os: This built-in JIT setup requires iOS 26 or later.
en.jit.setup.container: Install LSX4 directly with Sideloadly. Its built-in helper cannot run inside LiveContainer.
en.jit.setup.signature.error: This copy does not allow debugging. Reinstall with Sideloadly and your Apple Account using Apple ID Sideload. A distribution or enterprise signature cannot enable this JIT.
en.jit.setup.helper.error: The JIT helper is missing. Reinstall the IPA with Remove App Extensions disabled; keep LSX4JITHelper.
en.jit.setup.vpn.instructions: Install LocalDevVPN, open it and connect. Allow the VPN configuration when iOS asks. Keep Wi-Fi and LocalDevVPN on when starting a game.
en.jit.setup.pairing.instructions: Export the pairing file for this iPhone with iloader on your computer. Save it in Files, then select it below. Use your own phone’s file, not one sent with an IPA.
en.jit.setup.private: This is a private file for your iPhone. LSX4 does not send it to the IPA author or include its contents in diagnostics.
en.jit.setup.import.success: Pairing file saved. Connect LocalDevVPN, then check the connection or open a game.
en.jit.setup.import.error: This is not a complete pairing file. Export a fresh pairing file with iloader. Your previous file has been kept.
en.jit.setup.pairing.error: Import this iPhone’s pairing file in Settings → Set up JIT.
en.jit.setup.ready: Connection checked. The device is ready; open a game to enable JIT automatically.
en.jit.setup.connection.error: Could not prepare the device. Keep the screen unlocked, connect Wi-Fi and LocalDevVPN, then retry. If pairing has expired, import a fresh file.
en.jit.setup.automatic: JIT is enabled automatically when you open a game. The first preparation can take longer; subsequent launches reuse the device image cache.
en.jit.setup.library.help: Use Import game to select a PS4 PKG or an extracted game folder containing eboot.bin and sce_sys/param.sfo. Manual folders are detected at LSX4/CUSA12345 or LSX4/Games/CUSA12345. A Games folder is optional. Set up JIT in Settings before playing; compatibility remains game-specific.
en.pkg.import.title: Import game
en.pkg.import.instructions: Choose your PS4 PKG or an already-extracted game folder. For a folder, select the one that contains eboot.bin and sce_sys/param.sfo. LSX4 installs it on this device and adds it to the library.
en.pkg.import.supported: PS4 base-game PKGs and complete extracted folders. Standalone update/DLC PKGs and PS5 packages are not supported. Complete folders with already merged updates are accepted. Existing games are never overwritten. Keep LSX4 open during import.
en.pkg.import.done: {title} imported. The game is now in your library.

ru.jit.setup.os: Для встроенного JIT нужна iOS 26 или новее.

ru.jit.setup.library.help: Через «Импорт игры» выберите PS4 PKG или готовую папку с eboot.bin и sce_sys/param.sfo. Папки определяются также по путям LSX4/CUSA12345 и LSX4/Games/CUSA12345; Games необязательна. Настройте JIT перед запуском; совместимость зависит от игры.
ru.pkg.import.title: Импорт игры
ru.pkg.import.instructions: Выберите PS4 PKG или готовую папку игры с eboot.bin и sce_sys/param.sfo. LSX4 установит игру на устройстве и добавит её в библиотеку.
ru.pkg.import.supported: Базовые PS4 PKG и готовые папки игр. Отдельные PKG обновлений/DLC и PS5 не поддерживаются. Полные папки с уже объединённым обновлением принимаются. Существующие игры не перезаписываются. Оставляйте LSX4 открытым.
ru.pkg.import.done: {title}: импорт завершён. Игра добавлена в библиотеку.
